title: Heyawake Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid tiled by rectangular rooms; some rooms carry a clue for how many of their cells are black

width.description: Grid width in cells (number of columns)

height.description: Grid height in cells (number of rows)

rooms.description: Rectangular rooms tiling the grid exactly

r.description: Zero-based row of the room's top-left cell

c.description: Zero-based column of the room's top-left cell

clue.description: Number of black cells required in this room, or null if unclued
